combo_4_species %>% 
  filter(., `Target Name`=="Beluga") %>% 
  dplyr::select(Sample_date, Site.Name=River, Quantity, index_scores, nReads) %>% 
filter(., Site.Name %in% c("Kenai", "Twentymile")) %>% 
mutate(., Site.Name=case_when(Site.Name=="Kenai" ~"Kenai River",
                             Site.Name=="Twentymile" ~"Twentymile River" )) %>% 
  mutate(eDNA_detection = case_when(Quantity | index_scores | nReads >0 ~"Yes",TRUE ~"No")) %>% left_join(beluga_visual_3) %>% 
  filter(., !is.na(Were.belugas.observed.during.the.monitoring.session.)) %>% 
  mutate(., Detection = case_when(eDNA_detection =="Yes" & Were.belugas.observed.during.the.monitoring.session. =="Yes" ~"Both Detected",
                                  eDNA_detection =="Yes" & Were.belugas.observed.during.the.monitoring.session. =="No" ~"eDNA Only",
                                  eDNA_detection =="No" & Were.belugas.observed.during.the.monitoring.session. =="Yes" ~"Visual Only",
                                   eDNA_detection =="No" & Were.belugas.observed.during.the.monitoring.session. =="No" ~"Both Absent"
)) %>% 
  count(Detection) %>% 
  ggplot(., aes(x=Detection, y=n, fill=Detection)) +geom_bar(stat="identity")  +theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust = 1)) +ylab("Count") + xlab("Detection Type") +theme_pubr()+theme(legend.position = "none",axis.text.x = element_text(angle=30, hjust = 1), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
panel.background = element_blank(), axis.text = element_text(size=16), axis.title = element_text(size=24), strip.text = element_text(size=16), axis.line = element_line(colour = "grey50"))
